A state that fabricates activity is launch-blocking — see
`docs/product-principles.md`. Please fill every field you can.

## What the board claimed

Task state, worker states, needs, or finish detail as shown.

## What actually happened

What the host/repository/tools actually did.

## Evidence panel contents

The text shown under "Evidence" (includes each state's provenance).

## Which provenance label was on the wrong state?

- [ ] observed
- [ ] reported
- [ ] derived
- [ ] don't know

## Reproduction

Steps, or the smallest `npm run replay -- <fixture>` / eval case that shows it.
